answer: Use aged work identity throttling: new identities must complete 10 CPU-minutes of useful validation and wait 72 hours before their actions count. A jade ledger entry timestamps the wait, so copying an identity restarts it and loses score. Clones each pay that compute and delay, making an oasis of fake accounts linearly costly to seed. An honest agent keeps one island of history, while every clone costs 10 CPU-minutes plus 72 hours and earns zero trust.
